title: FA/68/1976 of BHAWANI DUTT KALA  and OTHERS Vs SMT. ANAR DEVI

paras.text:
MCC No. 531 of 2013
CLMA No. 9172 of 2013
In
FA No. 820 of 2001 (Old No. 68 of 1976)
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate, present for the
appellants/applicants.
This is Delay Condonation Application
(CLMA) No. 9172 of 2013, filed with the Recall
Application (MCC) No. 531 of 2013, for recall of
order dated 10.04.2007, passed in First Appeal
No. 820 of 2001 (Old No. 68 of 1976).
Heard.
The first appeal of 1976 was dismissed as
infructuous on 10.04.2007, after about 30 years,
and said order shows that the then counsel for the
appellant Shri Pankaj Kumar Kaushik and Shri
Nagesh Agarwal, the then counsel for the
respondent made the statement before this Court
that the appeal has become infructuous. In said
circumstances, this Court dismissed the appeal as
infructuous.
Now, after a period of six years by engaging
another counsel appellant wants to get recalled the
order passed by this Court.
It is not a case of the appellants/applicants
that they have been defrauded by anyone.
In the above circumstances, having
considered submissions of learned counsel for the
appellants/applicants and after going through the
affidavits filed in support of the two applications,
this Court finds that there is neither any ground
sufficient for condonation of delay, nor there any
sufficient ground for recalling the order dated
10.04.2007.
Therefore, the Delay Condonation
Application (CLMA) No. 9172 of 2013 and Recall
Application (MCC) No. 531 of 2013, are hereby
dismissed.
 (Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
29.08.2013
JM
